dedupe_keys.name: ebu tr 051 measuring techniques for dab coverage performance 2020

description: EBU Technical Report 051, dated April 2020, covers the measurement of DAB and DAB+ coverage: why measurements are needed, the technical prerequisites, use cases for measuring network coverage with the techniques, parameters and requirements for each, and the requirements for the measuring equipment and its operation. It gives details of the relevant DAB parameters, such as carrier-to-noise, bit error rate, modulation error ratio, field strength and site acceptance tests, together with the results of some measurements made to identify a possible method for objective assessment of network and reception quality. Producer: the EBU, Geneva. Coverage: methods for DAB networks in general, with examples. Access: a free 48-page PDF on the EBU technical website. Licence and cost: no licence text read; free. Caveats: a measurement method report, not a dataset, and the measurement results inside were only skimmed from the abstract. Simulation uses: the measurement definitions support calibration and validation of DAB coverage and network-planning models. Related records: EBU TR 024 on SFN planning for T-DAB and DVB-T (data-ebu-tr-024-sfn-planning-t-dab-dvb-t) and the WorldDAB country status data (data-worlddab-country-status-digital-radio).
